editor_note: Shared product catalog for Small Space Greens. Names, variant, size, and destination URLs follow the live listings last checked on 10 November 2026. On 12 November 2026, typographic Amazon cards were replaced with that ASIN's own Amazon listing photograph, hotlinked from Amazon's image CDN and not rehosted. Crop photos remain on seed and collection cards. The Verdana coir brick keeps its licensed coir-brick photograph. Etekcity 0.1 g scale (B08BPTXK4L) stays typographic because the listing is currently unavailable and no main product photograph was found. Future Amazon picks always use the listing photograph via image.image_embed.

image_policy.official: Merchant-permitted official product photo, hosted as WebP without recoloring.
image_policy.licensed-exact: A third-party licensed photo of the same product type, credited, not a different item.
image_policy.crop: A licensed photo of the named crop. Identifies the crop, not the merchant packet.
image_policy.neutral: Typographic card. Used only when no permitted exact product photograph, including a listing main image, is available.
image_policy.image_embed: Hotlinked Amazon image URL on m.media-amazon.com for amazon-treatment cards, or a Creators API URL when that is in use. Never download or rehost Amazon images.
image_policy.amazon: Main product photograph from that ASIN's Amazon listing, hotlinked from m.media-amazon.com. Never downloaded or rehosted. Future Amazon picks use this treatment.
